integrity: The general finite-size assertion is proved using minimal-neighborhood antichains and inclusion-exclusion; computational checks on carriers through size three are supporting evidence rather than an infinite proof. Prior normal-filter cases and Dedekind number values are credited.
limitations: The theorem concerns finite nonempty carriers and nonempty upward-closed local families excluding the empty set. Infinite and nonproper families, and full-product logic completeness, are not classified.
title: A singleton-or-principal criterion for converse mixing in finite monotone neighborhood products
